english:
Precision Kills grant a stack of Damage Boost while Solo, with no maximum.

Each stack grants 1.2% increased Weapon Damage against Combatants, up to 30% increased Weapon Damage at 25 stacks.

All stacks are lost on death.

Stacks with everything.
